title: On Accepting the offer
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：accept　|　正文 315 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 accept 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the guide ① accepted the offer with great care, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the guide ② accepts the offer on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ accept the offer at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ accepted the offer before — a line in the guidebook for July 1964 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Accepting the offer with great care, the guide said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the map at the far ledge, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ accept the blame on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Accept the blame at once and never mention it again.

By 1977 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the guidebook, and a new traveller from the next valley ⑧ accepts the blame with great care every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the ledge, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ accepted the offer again when nobody else would.

⑩ To accept the offer, my mother said in 1982, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the valley remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the valley forgets, somebody accepts the offer on the same day again and somebody must accept the offer with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 接受（一般过去式 accepted the offer：1970 年向导头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 接受（一般现在 accepts the offer：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 接受（不定式 to accept the offer：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 接受（过去完成时 had accepted the offer：1964 年七月的旅行手册上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 接受（动名词 accepting the offer 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 承担（accept the blame：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去承担那份责难）
G. v. 承担（accept the blame：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 接受（后段两处：新来的旅人照例 accepts the blame，而母亲又一次 accepted the offer）

items.q: accept the blame on the same day
accepts the blame with great care

answers.why: accept 意为“接受”，1970 年向导小心翼翼地接受那份提议，那是山谷里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 accepted。
accept 意为“接受”，自那以后向导当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 accepts。
accept 意为“接受”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯接受那份提议”，此处为不定式 to accept the offer。
accept 意为“接受”，旅行手册里 七月 那行字说明早在 1977 年之前就有人接受过，故用过去完成时 had accepted。
accept 意为“接受”，向导说“接受那份提议这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 accepting the offer 作主语。
accept 意为“承担”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去承担那份责难”，should ever 之后用原形 accept the blame。
accept 意为“承担”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻承担那份责难（accept the blame at once），以后再也不要提起。
accept 意为“接受”，新来的旅人每个日子都照例承担那份责难，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 accepts。
accept 意为“接受”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地接受那份提议，用一般过去式 accepted 叙述。
accept 意为“接受”，结尾那句是母亲 1982 年的话：要接受那份提议，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和山谷记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，向导小心翼翼地接受那份提议；山谷里每一个旅人都说这是头一回。（accepted the offer）
多年以后，向导仍当天就做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（accepts the offer）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯接受那份提议这件事本身。（to accept the offer）
早在 1964 年就有人接受那份提议，七月那天旅行手册上的一行字就是证据。（had accepted the offer）
向导说过，小心翼翼地接受那份提议这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（accepting the offer 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻承担那份责难，以后再也不要提起。（accept the blame，祈使句）
answers: In 1970 the guide accepted the offer with great care, and every traveller in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three days on, the guide still accepts the offer on the same day without being asked.
My mother said later that to accept the offer at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had accepted the offer long before 1977, and the line in the guidebook for July proves it.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 accept 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the guide accepted the offer with great care, and nobody in the valley forgot it.
Even now the guide accepts the offer on the same day whenever the valley asks.
Accepting the offer with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever accept the blame on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next valley accepts the blame with great care every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother accepted the offer again, and the valley remembered that half.
